rows.theDefect: VF01, verifiedAtBase 7e01df1d8, FAIL on SELF_HELP_STOP: the committed track registry names five selfHelpStopConditions for track va_exp_nonconviction and the packet stated none of them. The packet said 'it is not legal advice', which states what the packet is rather than where the participant's own case leaves its reach. VF03 had measured the same absence at e80c4a759 and recorded the Dotson screen, the twenty-one-day objection window and the prior-record/felony case under observations rather than failing the obligation; VF01 ruled the other way on the same bytes and this lane repairs to VF01's reading.

theRepair.readAtBuildTime: A new selfHelpStops() in the builder reads data/record-clearing/legal-design-track-registry.json at build time for trackId va_exp_nonconviction. It asserts the track exists, asserts selfHelpStopConditions is non-empty, asserts one of them names Dotson, and asserts the matching Dotson exclusion is present. Nothing is hard-coded: the conditions are printed in the registry's own words and in the registry's own order, so the packet cannot drift from the record and cannot silently lose one. This is the shape FIX86 gave Colorado in scripts/build-census-v1-co_motion_seal_nonconviction-set.mjs and the shape the Vermont host carries.
theRepair.composedFilingInstructionsPage: The composed filing_instructions page now carries three new sections after the fee block and before WHAT THIS PACKET IS NOT: 'THE DOTSON SCREEN, A HARD GATE ON THE BASIS ELECTION IN PART ONE', which quotes the registry's condition 1 and the matching registry exclusion verbatim; 'WHERE SELF-HELP ENDS', which prints all five conditions verbatim, one bullet per declared condition; and 'WHO TO ASK WHEN YOU REACH ONE OF THEM'.
theRepair.dotsonPlacedAtTheBasisElection: Step 2 of WHAT YOU DO, IN ORDER -- the step that told the participant to 'Check exactly one basis box - acquitted, or nolle prosequi / otherwise dismissed' -- now ends by sending them to THE DOTSON SCREEN before they tick the second box, and that section sits on the facing composed page. In participant-instructions.md the same is done twice at the two places the Part 1 basis election is read: step 2 of 'What you must do' points to the '### The Dotson screen - a hard gate on the Part 1 basis election' block that immediately follows the list, and the 'Nothing about the basis of the petition is decided for you' paragraph under 'What the packet answered for you' now says the election is not unconstrained and names the gate.
theRepair.participantInstructions: participant-instructions.md gains a '## Where self-help ends' section before '## What this packet is not', printing all five conditions verbatim as a list, citing the file, the track and the field they were read from.
theRepair.whoToAsk: Only who the repository's records and the existing packets already name. The clerk of the circuit court where the petition is filed answers procedural questions -- what to file, how the copy must be served, what that court requires -- which is who this packet already sends the participant to on three other pages; the page says in terms that the clerk cannot tell them whether their charge is eligible. The legal questions -- whether the Dotson screen catches the dismissal, whether the Sec. 19.2-392.2(F) presumption is available, what to do if the Attorney for the Commonwealth objects or answers or the court sets a contested hearing, and any immigration, juvenile or federal question -- are put to a lawyer licensed to practise in Virginia, or a legal-aid office reached through that same clerk's office. NO NAMED LAWYER, ORGANISATION OR REFERRAL SERVICE IS INVENTED: the VA memo and the track registry name none for this route, and none is stated.
theRepair.whatWasNotDisturbed: FIX74's composed fee block ('THE FILING FEE, AND ONE THING THIS PACKET DOES NOT TELL YOU', the Sec. 19.2-392.2(A) no-fee statement and the CCRE-fee sentence) is byte-for-byte the text it was, in the composed page and in the instructions. perCondition.condition: The dismissal followed a stipulation or a judicial finding of facts sufficient for guilt, or was a deferred or first-offender disposition. That is the Dotson screen and it is a hard gate: route to sealing, not expungement.
The attorney for the Commonwealth objects or answers, or the court sets a contested hearing.
The participant has a prior criminal record and the charge was a felony, so neither the presumption nor an easy stipulation is available.
